extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and their attorneys/agents preparing and filing an Information Disclosure Statement (IDS) with the USPTO
extracted.subtask_description: Completing and submitting a U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Information Disclosure Statement (PTO/SB/08a) in compliance with 37 CFR 1.97 and 1.98, including required citation details, certification, fees, and signature. Guidance covers what bibliographic/data elements to provide for U.S. patents, published applications, foreign documents, and non-patent literature, and how the examiner should mark and treat citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form purpose and scope (IDS not for 37 CFR 1.99)
rubrics_metrics.description: INFORMATION DISCLOSURE STATEMENT BY APPLICANT (Not for submission under 37 CFR 1.99).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This specific PTO/SB/08a form is for IDS filings under 37 CFR 1.97/1.98 and is not to be used for submissions under 37 CFR 1.99.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required identifying application metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Application Number, Filing Date, First Named Inventor, Art Unit, Examiner Name, Attorney Docket Number and Doc code (IDS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete application-identifying information so the IDS can be associated with the correct file. The form includes fields for these items and EFS Web reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. Patent citation details
rubrics_metrics.description: For each cited U.S. patent provide Cite No, Patent Number, Kind Code, Issue Date, Name of Patentee or Applicant of cited Document, and Pages/Columns/Lines where relevant passages or figures appear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Kind Codes of USPTO Patent Documents at www.uspto.gov or MPEP 901.04 for correct kind codes. If adding multiple U.S. patent citations, use the Add button to supply additional entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. Patent Application Publication citation details
rubrics_metrics.description: For each cited U.S. published application provide Cite No, Publication Number, Kind Code, Publication Date, Name of Patentee or Applicant of cited Document, and Pages/Columns/Lines where relevant passages or figures appear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Add button to include additional published application citations; include the same level of location specificity as for patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign patent document citation details and coding
rubrics_metrics.description: For each cited foreign patent document provide Cite No, Foreign Document Number, Country Code (two-letter WIPO ST.3), Kind Code, Publication Date, Name of Patentee or Applicant of cited Document, and Pages/Columns/Lines where relevant passages or figures appear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter the issuing office by the two-letter WIPO ST.3 code. Use appropriate kind symbols per WIPO Standard ST.16 if possible. For Japanese patent documents, indicate the year of the reign of the Emperor preceding the serial number. Applicant should place a check mark if an English language translation is attached. Use Add to include more entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-patent literature (NPL) citation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: For each cited non-patent literature item include author name (in CAPITAL LETTERS), title of the article (when appropriate), title of the item (book, magazine, journal, serial, symposium, catalog, etc.), date, page(s), volume-issue number(s), publisher, and city and/or country where published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full bibliographic detail to allow the examiner to locate the item. Use the Add button for additional NPL citations. Examiner initials field is provided for each NPL entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide specific location of relevant passages/figures
rubrics_metrics.description: For each cited document (patent, published application, foreign document, or NPL) indicate the Pages, Columns, Lines where relevant passages or relevant figures appear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplying precise location information helps the examiner assess relevance quickly and is requested on the form for all citation types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification statement options under 37 CFR 1.97
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant must select the appropriate certification under 37 CFR 1.97 and 1.98: either (1) that each item was first cited in any communication from a foreign patent office in a counterpart foreign application not more than three months prior to filing the IDS (37 CFR 1.97(e)(1)); OR (2) that no item was cited in a communication from a foreign patent office in a counterpart foreign application and, to the knowledge of the signer after making reasonable inquiry, no item was known to any individual designated in 37 CFR 1.56(c) more than three months prior to filing (37 CFR 1.97(e)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select and complete the appropriate certification; see attached certification statement if more detail is required. The second option requires making 'reasonable inquiry' and attesting to knowledge limits of designated individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee indication per 37 CFR 1.17(p)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(p) has been submitted with the IDS or that a certification statement is not submitted with the fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark the appropriate option on the form. Check fee rules in 37 CFR 1.17(p) for applicable amounts and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature and signature form requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: A signature of the applicant or representative is required in accordance with CFR 1.33 and 10.18. Provide Signature, Date (YYYY-MM-DD), Name/Print, and Registration Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See CFR 1.4(d) for the required form of signature. The signer must be authorized (applicant or registered practitioner) and provide the registration number when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner handling and marking of citations
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiner: Initial if reference considered, whether or not citation is in conformance with MPEP 609. Draw line through a citation if not in conformance and not considered. Include copy of this form with next communication to applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiners must indicate consideration by initialing each citation; if a citation is not in conformance with MPEP 609 and will not be considered, the examiner should strike it out. A copy of the completed IDS form should be included with the next Office action or communication to the applicant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kind code and country code standards guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Use USPTO Kind Codes (see MPEP 901.04) for U.S. patent documents and WIPO Standard ST.16 symbols for kinds of foreign documents; enter foreign issuing office by two-letter WIPO ST.3 country code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow USPTO and WIPO standards for correctly coding kind and country identifiers to avoid ambiguity. The form explicitly references these sources for correct coding.

rubrics_metrics.name: English translation attachment indication
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant is to place a check mark if English language translation is attached for foreign patent documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate on the form when an English translation accompanies a cited foreign document to facilitate examiner review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy Act notice and consequences of non-furnishing
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnishing of the information solicited is voluntary, but the principal purpose of the information is to process/examine the application; failure to furnish requested information may prevent the USPTO from processing/examining the submission and may result in termination of proceedings or abandonment of the application or expiration of the patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Privacy Act statement also lists routine uses (e.g., disclosures to DOJ, Congress, contractors, WIPO International Bureau, other agencies for national security/atomic energy reviews, GSA inspections, law enforcement). Applicants should be aware of confidentiality limits under 35 U.S.C. 122 and 37 CFR 1.14.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative handling instructions (copies and recordkeeping)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include copy of this form with next communication to applicant; records from this system may be disclosed as routine uses including when application is published or patent issued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form instructs examiners to include the IDS copy in subsequent communications; the Privacy Act/FOIA discussion explains disclosure practices for records related to published or issued applications.
